purpose: The creation block of every scored account (all suspicious and known_good rows of scan/dataset.json), proven from the chain, and its replay block at each age point. Input of the at-age replay; the engine never reads this file. No label is recorded here.

method.creation: The first block at which archival view_account finds the account: view_account at that block answers the account, and at its predecessor (the block whose hash is its prev_hash) answers UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT. The search starts at the oldest transaction that touches the account in FastNEAR's transactions API and walks forward block by block (bisection when the account does not appear within 40 heights).
method.replay_block: The first block whose timestamp is at or after creation + days * 86400 s: its timestamp is at or after the target and its predecessor's is before it. Found by interpolation and bisection over archival block heights.
method.exists: view_account at the replay block: an account that answers UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT there is excluded at that age point and gets no snapshot.
method.cross_checks: Recorded, never used to choose a block: the dataset's facts.created_at and facts.creation_tx (creation expected 0 to 600 s after created_at), and NearBlocks v3 GET /v3/accounts/{id} (created, deleted). Powered by Nearblocks.io APIs.
